_meta.what: C-1 normal controls on a real archived scan
not_done: no new statistic claimed as an improvement

duplication.why: the mean removes the 1/N factor, but the producer's stride subsample is a function of N (8000 -> step 6, 16000 -> step 13) and the k-nearest-neighbour neighbourhood is a function of the point set, so the same physical scan scores differently at different input sizes. The defect is in the evaluation sample, not in the missing 1/N

density.note: a mean does not drift with density by construction; the spread is the normal-estimation noise from keeping half the points, not a scale defect

physical_scale.interpretation: the translation block is scale-invariant (normals do not see a uniform zoom) while the rotational block grows as s^2; this weak direction is translation-dominated, so its projection does not move with the scene's metric scale. A constant floor on such a direction is therefore an angular-diversity statement, not a distance one

direction_selection.note: the fixed-direction projection and the own-minimum are different quantities; no per-frame own-weak maximum bounds the other (review correction, restated as a control)
